records.detail: Current consolidated hunting-object list (Order No. 18, publication 10/08/2023) was not public.
Current consolidated fishing regulation (22/06/2026) was not public. Commercial and recreational rules were not extracted.
APA17, APA29, MEPA51, and MEPA52 have no downloaded GeoJSON.
Order No. 95 prohibits hunting inside city administrative boundaries. Official city geometry was not retrieved, so this does not become permission outside a known boundary.
Akhalkalaki, Ninotsminda, Tsalka, and Dmanisi are named in Annex 1. Their boundary geometry was not retrieved.
500-meter and 250-meter buffers are legal distances in the sources. No buffer geometry was generated.
The retrieved order gives Georgian and scientific names. English common names were not in the source and were not invented.
Third Saturday in the consolidated order versus fourth Saturday and 22 August 2026 in the ministry announcement.
